avoid_supplements.name: High-dose Vitamin D (>4000 IU daily without medical supervision)
avoid_supplements.mechanism: Denosumab increases hypocalcemia risk; excessive vitamin D supplementation may cause hypercalcemia rebound or complicate calcium-vitamin D balance management
avoid_supplements.action: Monitor serum calcium and vitamin D levels; use moderate doses only under physician guidance; maintain coordinated supplementation with prescriber

avoid_supplements.name: Calcium supplements (>1200 mg daily without coordination)
avoid_supplements.mechanism: Denosumab suppresses bone turnover and increases hypocalcemia risk; uncoordinated supplementation may mask or exacerbate electrolyte imbalances
avoid_supplements.action: Coordinate calcium supplementation with prescriber; monitor serum calcium levels; maintain consistent dosing patterns

caution_supplements.name: Phosphate binders or high-dose phosphate supplements
caution_supplements.mechanism: May affect mineral metabolism in context of denosumab-induced hypocalcemia
caution_supplements.action: Inform prescriber of use; monitor serum phosphate and calcium levels periodically

caution_supplements.name: Magnesium supplements
caution_supplements.mechanism: Denosumab therapy may alter magnesium homeostasis; supplementation may be beneficial but requires coordination
caution_supplements.action: Discuss with healthcare provider; monitor if used concurrently

avoid_foods.name: Inconsistent dairy intake patterns
avoid_foods.mechanism: Unpredictable dietary calcium intake complicates calcium-vitamin D management in setting of denosumab-induced hypocalcemia
avoid_foods.action: Maintain consistent dairy and calcium-rich food intake; coordinate with prescribed supplementation regimen

caution_foods.name: High phosphate processed foods
caution_foods.mechanism: Excessive dietary phosphate may affect calcium-phosphate balance during denosumab therapy
caution_foods.action: Maintain moderate intake of processed foods; focus on balanced mineral nutrition

caution_foods.name: Fortified foods with vitamin D
caution_foods.mechanism: Cumulative vitamin D intake may interact with denosumab's effects on calcium homeostasis
caution_foods.action: Account for dietary vitamin D sources when calculating total intake; coordinate with supplementation

monitoring_notes: Denosumab does not undergo hepatic metabolism and has minimal drug interactions, but careful monitoring of serum calcium, phosphate, magnesium, and vitamin D is essential due to its mechanism of action suppressing bone turnover. Coordinate all calcium and vitamin D supplementation with the prescriber to prevent hypocalcemia and maintain mineral homeostasis.
